# Breadcrumb

Breadcrumb shows where the current page is in the hierarchy and links to its parent pages. Use it on detail
pages several levels deep; the page title stays in the page header.

**Interaction**: links and buttons in the path are secondary text; hover adds the state layer, and `Tab` focus
shows the focus ring. The last item is the current page (`aria-current="page"`) and is not interactive. An item
with `menu` opens its dropdown menu on click or `Enter`, like Dropdown: focus moves into the menu and returns to
the item after closing.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Folder paths, the parent pages of a detail page, settings subpages

## Import

```ts
import { Breadcrumb } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

The path from the top level to the current page; the last item is the current page and is not a link.

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      items={[
        { title: 'Projects', href: '#projects' },
        { title: 'Website redesign', href: '#projects/website' },
        { title: 'Mockups' },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Buttons and menus

Items with only `onClick` are rendered as buttons (for navigation inside the application); `menu` opens a
dropdown menu with sibling pages.

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Variants() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      items={[
        { title: 'Files', onClick: () => {} },
        {
          title: 'Design',
          menu: {
            items: [
              { key: 'design', label: 'Design' },
              { key: 'marketing', label: 'Marketing' },
              { key: 'finance', label: 'Finance' },
            ],
          },
        },
        { title: 'Brand assets', onClick: () => {} },
        { title: 'Logos' },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly BreadcrumbItem[]` | The path from the top level to the current page; the last item is the current page and is not a link. Items with `href` are links; items with only `onClick` are rendered as buttons; items with `menu` are buttons that open a dropdown menu (such as sibling folders). | — | Yes |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the navigation landmark; the built-in text by default ("Breadcrumb"). | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### BreadcrumbItem

An item of a Breadcrumb.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Text of the item. | — | Yes |
| `href` | `string` | Address the item links to. | — | No |
| `onClick` | `(event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | Called when the item is clicked. An item with `onClick` and without `href` is rendered as a button. | — | No |
| `menu` | `DropdownMenu` | A dropdown menu opened by the item, such as sibling folders; the item is then a button. | — | No |

### DropdownMenu

The menu of a Dropdown.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly DropdownMenuItem[]` | Menu items: actions and dividers (`{ type: 'divider' }`). | — | Yes |
| `onClick` | `(info: { readonly key: string }) => void` | Called with the key of the chosen item; the menu closes afterwards. | — | No |
| `selectedKeys` | `readonly string[]` | Keys of the items shown as selected, such as the current option of a settings menu. | — | No |

### DropdownMenuItem

An item of a Dropdown menu: an action or a divider.

```ts
type DropdownMenuItem = DropdownMenuAction | DropdownMenuDivider
```

### DropdownMenuAction

An action in a Dropdown menu.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | Unique key, passed to the `onClick` of the menu. | — | Yes |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | Text of the item. | — | Yes |
| `icon` | `IconName \| IconComponent` | Icon before the text: a name, or an icon component such as Lucide's `Copy`. | — | No |
| `danger` | `boolean` | Destructive action, shown in the danger color. | — | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disabled: shown but cannot be chosen. | — | No |
| `shortcut` | `string \| readonly string[]` | Shortcut hint shown at the end of the item with Kbd, such as `'mod+c'`. Only a hint: register the shortcut itself with useHotkeys. | — | No |

### DropdownMenuDivider

A divider between groups of Dropdown menu items.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'divider'` | Marks the item as a divider. | — | Yes |
| `key` | `string` | Unique key; the position in the list by default. | — | No |

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`. Props that take an
icon also accept an icon component instead of a name (see IconComponent).

126 values, listed on the [Icon](Icon.md#types) page.

### IconComponent

An icon component, such as Lucide's `Plus` (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`), accepted wherever an icon name
is: `<Button icon={Plus}>`, `<Icon icon={Plus} />`, menu items and so on. Names (`icon="plus"`) are convenient
and work in data such as menu configurations, but cover only the registered icons (`iconNames`); a component can
be any Lucide icon, or an SVG of your own. Both are drawn with the same size, stroke width and `tone`.

```ts
type IconComponent = ComponentType<IconComponentProps>
```

### IconComponentProps

Props that Icon passes to an icon component. Lucide icons (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`) accept them; a
component of another icon set, or an SVG of your own, works too if it accepts them, or passes them on to its
`<svg>`.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `number` | Width and height in pixels. | — | No |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | Stroke width in the units of a 24 × 24 view box, already scaled for `size`: the line is 1.75 px wide on screen by default, whatever the size. | — | No |
| `color` | `string` | Stroke color: `currentColor` (the text color) or a semantic color variable, such as `var(--vl-color-danger)`. | — | No |
| `aria-hidden` | `boolean` | `true` for a decorative icon (hidden from screen readers). | — | No |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of a meaningful icon. | — | No |
| `role` | `string` | `img` for a meaningful icon. | — | No |
